name: adaptive-cognitive-memory
description: Adaptive cognitive memory: one cross-project memory database with local semantic search, budgeted hook recall, explicit curated capture and a self-diagnosing doctor.

recall_budget_tokens.title: Recall budget (tokens)
recall_budget_tokens.description: Most tokens of recalled memories injected at session start and on each prompt.

pretool_budget_tokens.title: Pre-tool recall budget (tokens)
pretool_budget_tokens.description: Most tokens of recalled memories injected before a Bash, Read, Edit or Write call.

download_model.title: Download the embedding model automatically
download_model.description: On first run, download onnx-community/granite-embedding-97m-multilingual-r2-ONNX (one time, about 120 MB) into the plugin data directory in the background. Turn off to run model-init yourself (see /memory-doctor).
